# Thorne

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Thorne  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Thorne is a young woman with light, curly hair and captivating eyes. She dresses gorgeously, wearing outfits with exceptionally puffy sleeves.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)_

## Personality

She is an intelligent, compassionate, and refined individual with very gentle spoken manners. As a dedicated educator, she possesses a talent for capturing her students' love while drawing out their finest intellectual and moral qualities. She actively encourages her students to reflect, investigate, and discover things independently.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P2](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0002), [v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013)_

- prepare her proficient pupils for Regent's entrance exam  <sub>[v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)</sub>

## History

Miss Agnes Thorne was hired as the new teacher for Brierley school, becoming the first female educator employed there. She introduced various innovative activities for her students, including physical culture exercises, bi-weekly recitation Friday afternoons, and field trips to the forest to study nature. In November, she proposed that the school organize a performance on Christmas Night to raise funds for a schoolhouse flag. She later established an after-school group to provide extra instruction for pupils preparing for the Regent's entrance exam. Although she received an offer to teach at a grade school in her home district, her strong interest in her Brierley pupils led her to stay for another year and guide them through their Entrance examinations. At the end of that final school term, she parted ways with her students upon completing her tenure at Brierley.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P6](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0006), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)_
